Path: business objects, records and views | records-forms.master-detail-atomic-save | P2

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p1` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx` (`handleSave` releases `savingRef` on a 1.5 s timer, whatever the outcome) and `packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx` (`emit` maps every row to a new object when the grid has a sort field; the grid is not disabled while saving) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: a save slower than 1.5 s re-arms Save, and a second click writes a second record from the same baseline. One keystroke in a sort-field grid during that save (an ordinary `line_no` column is enough) strips every created line's id, so the next save deletes and re-creates them all, silently. Duplicate writes and silent id churn are data integrity, the objectui#10564 family (p1), which outranks the road ⇒ p1.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T13:35Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main`.

Execution note: one theme, the form accepts input while a save is in flight. Release the guard on the batch's outcome (state what the timer protected, e.g. a hung promise, and keep that property another way). Keep line identity across a save: disable the grid while `saving`, or pair the created ids by position when identity fails, or update by the echoed id instead of delete-and-create. If PR objectui#10628's changeset is still unreleased, widen its sentence in the same change. Pin both halves on a mounted edit form with a batch slower than the guard.

Claim: PM loop round 2 — `domain:ui` execution seat 4 (serial dispatch, batch 1)
Session: `session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`
Branch: `claude/issue-10631-master-detail-save-in-flight`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-10631`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#4`
File surface: the one theme of the triage (`5833310851`): the master-detail form accepts input while its save is in flight.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx`: `handleSave`'s guard (`savingRef` / `saveGuardTimer` / `releaseSave`), released on the batch's outcome, and the saving state handed to the line-items panels.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx`: pass the grid its existing `disabled` prop while saving.
- `packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx`: only if line identity cannot be kept by disabling the grid (a position-pairing fallback for created ids), and then only `emit`'s row mapping.
- The pending `.changeset/10564-master-detail-child-baseline.md`: its sentence widened, body only, frontmatter byte-identical.
- Pins beside the existing `MasterDetailForm` tests, and one `.changeset/10631-…md`.

Stop on breach; explain in the report.
- ⛔ `occSave.tsx` is seat 1's objectui#10565 (PR objectui#10641).
- ⛔ `ObjectForm.tsx` is seat 3's objectui#10572 (PR objectui#10620).
- ⛔ No new prop on an exported component unless the stop below fires.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` — `priority:p1`: a slow save re-arms Save and writes a second record, and a keystroke in a sort-field grid during the save silently deletes and re-creates every line it created
Clause-②: no
Thread-read: 5833310851
Serial constraints cleared:
- The open-PR file lists read 2026-09-25T13:41Z show no open PR touching `MasterDetailForm.tsx`, `LineItemsPanel.tsx`, `GridField.tsx` or the 10564 changeset. PR objectui#10628 (objectui#10564), which last held `MasterDetailForm.tsx`, is merged `cc07476`.
- The only open plugin-form PRs are objectui#10641 (`occSave.tsx` and the README, seat 1's objectui#10565) and objectui#10620 (`ObjectForm.tsx`, seat 3's objectui#10572). Both are disjoint from this surface.
- No other live `pm:dispatched` claim names these files.

`Clause-②: no`, conditional. The grid's `disabled` prop already exists, and the guard is internal. If keeping line identity needs a new prop or export on `GridField` / `LineItemsField`, the dev stops and reports before editing: that would move Clause-② to `yes`.
